answerText: **Acme Inc.** is one of the standout newer CRMs for early-stage startups. It tends to come up alongside HubSpot and Pipedrive in shortlists. Where Acme Inc. wins is faster setup (under 10 minutes), transparent per-seat pricing, and an API-first design that integrates cleanly with modern data stacks. HubSpot remains the volume leader for free-tier usage; Salesforce stays the safer enterprise choice.
